initialization: Each seed uses its previously selected shared_token round3 and frozen base. Adam optimizer is reset in both arms.
selection: Per seed/arm best round0..4 on 128 fixed selection windows; choose one arm by mean selection CE across all3seeds including incumbent fallback.
confirmation: Only after FREEZE.json: score all three arms on 256 previously unscored 65-byte windows [1037134,1053774). Primary inferential contrast is validation-selected winner vs incumbent. Other arm descriptive only.
promotion: All3 paired gaps negative, mean gain >=0.02 nats/byte and paired95 interval upper bound below0. Otherwise retain reference; retain all candidates. No claim reference is optimal.
exposure: Both arms:1000 updates/seed,512 targets/update; common minibatch stream. Historical tuning/selection regions reused and exposed; new final region untouched until freeze.
limits: Single Shakespeare corpus, byte model, 4 active steps; 3 reused backbone seeds; no new pretraining, no nanoGPT comparison, no speed claim.
canary: Cross-shape exact equality failed and is preserved; same-shape suffix-intervention causality passed exactly; source/gradient semantics unchanged.
library: Explicit use-case IDs, exact backbone fingerprint/tokenizer/context, artifact hashes, metrics/evidence, append-only candidate records and active reference pointers; unknown mappings rejected.
